headline: Earnings per share turn positive but trail last year
summary_short: Quarterly EPS was ₹11.05 versus ₹26.54 a year ago, down 58.4%, after a loss of ₹8.91 per share in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Earnings per share of ₹11.05 compares with ₹26.54 in the same quarter a year earlier and a loss of ₹8.91 last quarter.
